objective: Dogfood TORC on one real implementation-to-review session handoff using a minimal operator CLI over the existing lineage, projection, acceptance, and authority primitives.
success_evidence: An operator can create and checkpoint a real lineage only through its authoritative activation.
Handoff preparation creates a derived human brief and reconstruction template without transferring authority.
A rejected reconstruction is preserved and leaves source authority unchanged, while an accepted reconstruction transfers the lease to the intended target activation.
The implementation-to-review transition for this change is completed through the new surface and the resulting store verifies cleanly.
non_goals: Adding a benchmark, paired experiment, provider adapter, inference call, daemon, service, watcher, network dependency, or parent Lugos edit.
Claiming TORC controls Autowork assignments, filesystem or tool permissions, or execution authority outside its lineage store.
Changing database schemas, acceptance semantics, branching, recovery, or multi-host synchronization.
Waiting for a multi-handoff study before deciding whether the operator surface is useful.
accepted_threats: The pilot is self-hosted on TORC development and therefore does not establish general usefulness.
Exact reconstruction equality is intentionally retained and may reject harmless paraphrases.
The local SQLite store provides tamper evidence and transactional lineage authority, not authentication against a malicious local process.
The operator still decides when a checkpoint or handoff boundary occurs.
